Mini-ITX-Gehäuse mit ATX-Netzteil

https://makerworld.com/de/models/3111127-mini-itx-case-with-atx-power-supply#profileId-3508134

### Mini-ITX PC case with ATX power supply and suppport for 300mm long GPU

Boost MeBoost me if you liked this model! This took me so many hours to complete and few failed prints, but now it is available for free!

### Introduction

This Mini-ITX case is designed for powerful components and it is very sturdy so you can take it with you everywhere you go. 

* Side panels are easy to take off for easy acces.
* Supports ATX Power supply.
* Over 300mm space for GPU when front fan is removed
* Keep your pc cool with 2 120mm fan mounts, 1 in fornt and 1 in top. Lots of airflow!
 

### Materials needed

I recommend buying set that includes various lenghts of M screws.

Those lengts does not have to be exactly as mentioned. Most of times you can use a bit longer or shorter ones.

 

Screws

* M2x6 screws 4pcs
* M3x14 screws 2pcs
* M3x20 screws 2pcs
* M4x15 screws 18pcs
* M4x20 screws 15pcs
* M4x25 screws 3pcs
* M4x35 screws 1pcs
* M4x45 screws 1pcs
* 6mm motherboard standoffs with M3 screw 4pcs
* Regular hdd M3 screws 1-5pcs depending if you want to mount 2.5&#34; ssd/hdd to base. 1 is needed for PSU extension cable cover.
Heat inserts (these does not have to match perfectly)

* M2x4x3.6 inserts 4pcs
* M3x5.7x4.6 inserts 9 pcs
* M4x8.1x6.3 inserts 37 pcs
Magnets

* 3x1mm 20pcs (Optional) Only needed if you want to you dust mesh!
* 10x2mm 20pcs
 

 

You will also need atleast power button and electric plug extensions.

If you dont want front ports, choose the plate without front ports (8-11)

Those parts can be ordered from aliexpress or from your favourite site.

* Power plug extension choose right one and 1 cable for it, I just cut old power cable and soldered it.
* Power button, choose 3-6v voltage and 12mm size
* USB 3 port
* USB C cable
* 3.5mm jack
* PCIE extension. Use what you have or order as fast cable as you need.
I have not yet figured out how to make the 3.5mm connector work when plugging the headphones, but i will update once it is done.

 

### All screw, insert and magnet locations are marked in the PDF file found at documentation section, or from here: Documentation 

If you have any problems or questions feel free to ask and i will help you!

 

Thank you!

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 4 walls, 15% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 4
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: ABS (#000000), PLA (#000000), TPU (#161616)
